test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

At times he acted as viceroy in William's absence; at times he led the royal forces to ______ rebellions.
solution: The correct answer is **"chastise."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Chastise"** means to punish or scold someone for their behavior. (ग़लती के लिए आलोचना या निंदा करना; डाँटना) • **Example**: *Charity organizations have **chastised**__ the government for not doing enough to prevent the latest famine in Africa.* • In the given sentence, it makes sense that the royal forces would be used to punish or quell rebellions. • The sentence structure also supports this, as the phrase **"to chastise rebellions"** fits grammatically. • The correct answer is option 2. **Correct sentence**: *At times he acted as viceroy in William's absence; at times he led the royal forces to __**chastise**__ rebellions.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Scrutinize**: to examine or inspect closely. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) सावधानी से देखना या जाँचना) • **Compromise**: to settle a dispute by finding middle ground. (अभीष्‍ट से कुछ कम पर मान जाना, विशेषतः सुलह या समझौते के लिए) • **Baptise**: to perform a religious ritual of initiation. (बपतिस्‍मा करना) 1e7:Ta17, The correct answer is **"I am willing to consider the possibility."**
